Automatic payout is forced off and approval requires a different actor. BLOCKED_OWNER remains a literal release blocker, but it is not yet the only blocker: the legacy payout request route and multi-step payout persistence still need one transactional canonical writer proof before this task can honestly resolve to BLOCKED_OWNER alone.
openBlockers: Commercial + Finance + Legal must approve the base currency, versioned commission rule, eligibility and attribution window, payout fee/minimum, reversal/dispute treatment and tax responsibility.
The legacy /api/partners payout request path does not append payout.requested to the canonical ledger, and payout row/link/ledger effects are not proven atomic under failure or concurrency.
Current-SHA full real-PostgreSQL concurrent request and cold-reopen acceptance should be rerun after the approved policy fixture exists; running it now would fabricate the owner decision.
